about: Model calls a body makes through the Identity Agent that keeps the API key, worked through; the rules are in contracts/model-call/model-call.schema.json. Each start arrives as its request written as JSON (or as raw, padded to raw_pad_to) and is checked against example_profile, or its own profile, under its model (the model chosen for the AI agent, where one is) and allowance (whether its model calls are held to an allowance). example_profile is made up for these vectors: it is not any provider's, and the routes, headers, query parameters and answer-length names in it are not part of the exchange. Each outcome is what the request alone decides; what only the Identity Agent knows (the lease, the AI agent's standing, what an allowance has left) is not in it.
